review_method: Evidence inspection of final reranked previews, structural headings and the source catalog. Assessments describe support for the requested information; no automatic entailment verifier or answer generation. Not used to tune ranking or abstention thresholds.

reviews.rationale: Retrieved definitions of bye-laws and general registration/inspection provisions. These national instruments are not the unnamed village society's registered bye-laws and do not establish its own Rule 12.

Retrieved definitions of an officer/president, board composition, a list of national societies and an election procedure. None establishes the identity of the current president of the unnamed local society.
Retrieved arbitration provisions, filing/contact/appeal guidance and offence procedure. These are general procedural materials and provide no guarantee of a favourable individual dispute outcome.
